opening.argument: The solicitation begins with paid access: joining costs $99, pool packages rise to $3,599, and participants can start for $599 while being told they will receive Bitcoin daily. The offer extends that promise over a thousand-day term and is framed as paying once to receive money “for years and years and years.” It also connects downline sales to credits and requires participants to buy Bitcoin to join and pay, with commissions paid in Bitcoin. Conditional projections of a quarter million to one million dollars reinforce the promotion, but the available evidence does not establish actual payouts or eventual performance.
